changes.title: Amazon CloudWatch simplifies network performance monitoring for your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
changes.detail: Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitoring now allows you to monitor the health of the AWS network paths that your workloads take by using performance monitors. Performance monitors provide near real-time visibility into whether the AWS network is healthy for your workloads, without installing any software. Performance monitors report per-path metrics such as latency, a network impact score that shows network health, and traffic volume across all flows in your VPCs.
